faq:
How does ordering work? | You put together your selection on the site, then send it to Fati on WhatsApp. She confirms availability, the actual delivery costs and the total before any payment.
How do I pay for my order? | Nothing is paid on the site. Once availability and delivery costs are confirmed, Fati tells you by message how to pay, then prepares your parcel.
Do you deliver to my country? | Fati ships from Spain to the European Union. Delivery times and costs depend on the country: they are confirmed with you before you order.
Can I return a product? | Yes. You have 14 days from receipt to change your mind, except for products that have been unsealed, for hygiene reasons. Full details are on the Delivery & returns page.
Can supplements replace a treatment? | No. Food supplements do not replace a varied diet, a healthy lifestyle or the advice of a healthcare professional. Fati gives no medical advice.
How do I choose a product? | Each product page lists the ingredients, size and directions for use. For general guidance, message Fati; for any health question, talk to a professional.
contact_intro: A question about a product, a course or a collaboration? Message Fati directly.
